text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're turning the interview back on 
me...!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! I am deeply grateful to you 
for interviewing our academy's students 
and sharing their stories every day!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely want you to keep putting 
yourself out there! To do that, building 
trusting relationships with the students 
is essential! Therefore, I'd like to set 
up a reverse-interview session!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for troubling you with this 
sudden idea. However, I don't believe this 
is a bad deal for your paper either...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If it means conveying the 
splendor of Umamusume even further, it 
would be my absolute honor!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If it is for that purpose... then I, the 
unworthy Etsuko Otonashi, shall answer 
anything you wish!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, Umamusume are all so full of 
curiosity...! Ah, what if they uncover my 
lineage back to its very origin, or even 
predict my future descendants... !?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They won't go quite that far, so please 
don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"By the way... Chairwoman Akikawa. I 
believe your proposal this time is also 
entirely for the sake of the academy and 
the students."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
In my humble opinion, it feels as though 
the intention is to provide an opportunity 
for students to reflect on how they are 
perceived by others...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I've designed it so that through a 
single phenomenon, various effects can be 
achieved.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought! The Chairwoman is 
someone with deep love for her students. I 
figured she had more than one aim in mind. 
Now, regarding the details of thatâ

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman! The interview about your 
reverse-interview has already started~!
